name: Pinpoint
design_intent:
TRIALS PRECISION_LAND proof course (v7_trials_challenge_types.md §2.6, example t_pinpoint). Kill your velocity and touch down SOFTLY on each tiny pad; a land_target latches `landed` only if the overlapping player arrives under land_speed_max -- a too-fast slam flashes red and does NOT latch (re-approach slower; that is the skill, not a death). Each target sits on a small marshmallow perch (lowest bounce) so a controlled descent settles. Clear-test = every group 'trials_target' member landed. A void fall respawns (+2s).

MEDAL (time): a controlled run soft-lands 3 pads in ~10-18s. gold 12.0 / silver 20.0 / bronze 34.0. land_speed_max 400 (forgiving proof value).
